jobs.title: Director, Data Analytics
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Data Analytics based in Canada.

We are looking for an experienced data and analytics leader to drive the successful activation, monitoring, and optimization of AI-powered solutions for enterprise clients. In this strategic leadership role, you will oversee a high-performing team of data scientists and analysts while shaping the programs that connect AI model performance with measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex client onboarding initiatives, establish scalable performance monitoring frameworks, and develop advanced analytics and experimentation capabilities. Working closely with Machine Learning Engineers, Support teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value and continuously improve over time. This is an exciting opportunity to combine technical expertise, people leadership, and program management within a fast-paced, innovation-driven technology environment.

Accountabilities

Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of Data Scientists and Analysts responsible for measuring, monitoring, and evaluating sophisticated AI model pipelines.
Oversee day-to-day team management, providing technical guidance, coaching, performance feedback, and long-term career development opportunities.
Drive the strategic planning and execution of AI client onboarding programs, ensuring smooth coordination and successful deployment across the client portfolio.
Develop and implement scalable frameworks to monitor client portfolio performance, AI model effectiveness, business impact, and return on investment.
Automate performance tracking, reporting, and diagnostic processes to improve operational efficiency and provide consistent visibility into AI-driven business outcomes.
Establish rigorous analytical standards and ensure the delivery of accurate, reliable, and actionable insights across all team initiatives.
Design and implement comprehensive performance reporting and diagnostic playbooks that equip Support teams with the tools and insights needed to address client questions and demonstrate AI performance.
Lead the investigation and resolution of complex performance escalations, collaborating closely with Machine Learning Engineers and other technical teams to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
Oversee the development and deployment of commercial-grade tracking, observability, and experimentation solutions that improve transparency and enable continuous AI optimization.
Translate model performance data and technical findings into scalable reporting frameworks and experimentation strategies that demonstrate measurable client value.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, and Client Support teams to align priorities, streamline workflows, and improve the overall AI activation process.
Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, analytical methodologies, and industry best practices to strengthen the organization's capabilities and maintain a competitive advantage.
Communicate program progress, performance insights, operational challenges, and strategic recommendations to internal stakeholders and senior leadership.

Requirements

At least 7 years of combined experience in data analytics, technical program management, and leadership, ideally involving the measurement and monitoring of complex AI or machine learning model pipelines.
Demonstrated experience recruiting, developing, and leading technical teams, with strong people management skills and the ability to mentor data scientists and analysts.
Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
Proven program management expertise, including the ability to coordinate complex client onboarding initiatives, manage multiple priorities, and deliver projects within demanding timelines.
Strong technical proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience working with cloud data platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, AWS, or Amazon Redshift.
Advanced proficiency in Tableau, including the ability to develop sophisticated dashboards, performance reports, and data visualization solutions.
Strong understanding of the AI and machine learning model lifecycle, from initial discovery and experimentation through production deployment, performance monitoring, and ongoing evaluation.
Experience with statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and performance measurement methodologies, particularly for recommendation systems and propensity scoring models.
Ability to design and implement scalable monitoring, observability, diagnostics, and experimentation frameworks for deployed AI solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret complex performance data and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain sophisticated technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, client-facing teams, and cross-functional partners.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a consistent focus on analytical accuracy, operational excellence, and high-quality delivery.
Proven ability to manage complex escalations, coordinate technical investigations, and drive issues toward timely and sustainable resolution.
Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving technology environment with multiple concurrent initiatives.
Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset, with a strong interest in emerging AI technologies, machine learning advancements, and innovative analytical approaches.
Collaborative leadership style, with the ability to build strong relationships and align multidisciplinary teams around shared objectives.

Benefits

Competitive annual base salary ranging from CAD $225,000 to $290,000, depending on qualifications, relevant experience, technical expertise, and the final scope of the position.
Potential additional bonus, depending on the position ultimately offered.

You will define the technical strategy, oversee integration architecture, and establish reusable frameworks that improve delivery efficiency and customer experience. jobs.description:

In this role, you will oversee the platform's architecture, software development, database infrastructure, integrations, and production operations while leading its long-term modernization. You will work closely with an established engineering team across Canada and Vietnam, ensuring business continuity while driving the transition from legacy on-premises infrastructure to modern cloud-based solutions. A key priority will be maintaining critical financial operations, including mutual fund transactions, settlements, account bookkeeping, and regulatory reporting, while introducing AI-assisted development practices. This is an opportunity to lead the evolution of a profitable, mission-critical financial software product within a long-term, technology-focused investment environment.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Operations based in Canada.

We are seeking an experienced and strategically minded Director of Operations to lead and optimize the organization's IT infrastructure, distribution, logistics, and fulfillment operations across Canada and the United States. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will take ownership of end-to-end operational performance, overseeing everything from warehouse networks and transportation strategy to enterprise systems, data integrity, and inventory management. Combining executive-level leadership with hands-on operational involvement, you will drive efficiency, strengthen external partnerships, and ensure reliable fulfillment across eCommerce, retail, and wholesale channels. You will also champion AI-driven automation, modernize data infrastructure, and establish scalable processes that support sustainable business growth. Working closely with cross-functional teams and external service providers, you will play a critical role in improving operational performance, controlling costs, and enhancing the customer experience. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of operations within a fast-paced, technology-driven retail environment.

Accountabilities

Lead and execute the overall distribution and fulfillment strategy across eCommerce, retail, and wholesale channels throughout Canada and the United States.
Oversee the complete product distribution lifecycle, from factory handoff and inbound transportation to warehouse receiving, inventory movement, and final delivery to customers, retail stores, and wholesale partners.
Monitor fulfillment performance and continuously improve service levels, operational reliability, capacity planning, and cost efficiency across the distribution network.
Lead peak-season preparation, operational readiness, and contingency planning to ensure business continuity during periods of increased demand.
Develop and manage the freight, parcel, and transportation strategy, including carrier selection, rate negotiations, commercial agreements, and service performance.
Oversee inbound freight operations, customs procedures, brokerage relationships, and cross-border logistics, ensuring compliance and efficient movement of goods.
Identify and manage logistics cost-recovery opportunities, including duty drawback programs and other transportation-related savings initiatives.
Own fulfillment economics, including warehouse expenses, freight, parcel delivery, storage, and overall cost-to-serve, establishing visibility into cost per order and cost per unit.
Identify and implement cost-reduction initiatives, review major logistics invoices, resolve commercial discrepancies, and collaborate with Finance on budgets, accruals, and operational cost reporting.
Manage inventory flow between warehouses, retail locations, and sales channels in close collaboration with Demand and Inventory Planning teams.
Ensure accurate and timely inbound inventory receiving, identify potential stock movement constraints, and implement solutions before they affect product availability.
Lead returns and reverse logistics operations, improving processing speed, cost efficiency, and the reintegration of returned products into available inventory.
Collaborate with eCommerce, Customer Experience, and Product teams to resolve operational challenges related to returns and customer experience.
Act as the business owner for IT and operational system requirements across NetSuite, Shopify, third-party logistics (3PL) platforms, electronic data interchange (EDI), warehouse management systems (WMS), retail systems, and carrier integrations.
Own the organization's end-to-end data infrastructure, including ERP administration, system integrations, data transfers, and information integrity across eCommerce, point-of-sale (POS), EDI, banking, warehouse, and returns platforms.
Establish robust data governance practices, including daily system variance monitoring, discrepancy investigation, root-cause analysis, and prevention of data inconsistencies.
Oversee IT infrastructure availability, uptime, and incident resolution, directing managed service providers (MSPs) on endpoint, network, and identity administration.
Drive AI-first transformation across IT and distribution by redesigning manual processes, implementing automation solutions, and scaling existing prototypes into reliable operational tools.
Establish comprehensive documentation for systems, workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), process ownership, and potential failure points to ensure transparency and operational continuity.
Manage AI-related expenditure through clear budgets, cost monitoring, and per-model usage visibility.
Build and maintain operational dashboards and lead the transition from legacy business intelligence tools to an AI-native analytics infrastructure with a centralized source of truth for business metrics.
Establish consistent performance measurement standards across Finance and commercial teams, ensuring alignment on reporting definitions and operational KPIs.
Define, monitor, and improve key performance indicators, including fulfillment service-level agreements (SLAs), shipping accuracy, receiving speed, carrier performance, inventory accuracy, and logistics costs.
Lead regular performance reviews, investigate recurring operational issues, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained.
Own strategic and commercial relationships with 3PL providers, warehouses, carriers, freight forwarders, customs partners, and other critical logistics suppliers.
Manage external IT partners and software vendors, overseeing service agreements, deliverables, renewals, spending, and performance expectations.
Lead contract negotiations, commercial reviews, rate discussions, and senior-level escalations, ensuring external partners consistently meet agreed service standards.
Build and lead the IT, Logistics, and Fulfillment team, providing clear direction, coaching, and performance management while remaining actively involved in important operational decisions.
Develop accountability, problem-solving capabilities, and effective escalation practices within the team, empowering managers to oversee daily operations independently.
Collaborate closely with Demand Planning, Finance, eCommerce, Retail, Wholesale, Product, and Technology teams to align operational priorities with broader business objectives.

Oversee the complete product distribution lifecycle, from factory handoff and inbound transportation to warehouse receiving, inventory movement, and final delivery to customers, retail stores, and wholesale partners.
Monitor fulfillment performance and continuously improve service levels, operational reliability, capacity planning, and cost efficiency across the distribution network.
Lead peak-season preparation, operational readiness, and contingency planning to ensure business continuity during periods of increased demand.
Develop and manage the freight, parcel, and transportation strategy, including carrier selection, rate negotiations, commercial agreements, and service performance.
Oversee inbound freight operations, customs procedures, brokerage relationships, and cross-border logistics, ensuring compliance and efficient movement of goods.
Identify and manage logistics cost-recovery opportunities, including duty drawback programs and other transportation-related savings initiatives.
Own fulfillment economics, including warehouse expenses, freight, parcel delivery, storage, and overall cost-to-serve, establishing visibility into cost per order and cost per unit.
